subject: Medford Charter Review Recommendations
overview: The Charter Study Committee held a public information session to summarize its progress on reviewing the city charter and preview upcoming recommendations. The committee detailed provisional decisions regarding ward representation and mayoral appointment powers while soliciting final public input before the January survey deadline.

items.title: Introduction and Review Process
items.summary: Committee leadership introduced members and outlined the process for reviewing the city's four-decade-old charter with the goal of presenting recommendations in Fall 2024.

items.title: Public Outreach and Research Update
items.summary: The committee reported on its research efforts, including a city-wide survey with over 600 responses and a partnership with the Collins Center for Public Management at UMass Boston.

items.title: Provisional Recommendations and Voting
items.summary: The committee has provisionally voted to recommend hybrid ward representation for the city and to grant the City Council power to confirm mayoral appointments to multi-member boards.

items.title: Upcoming Review Topics
items.summary: Future meetings will address term limits, compensation processes for elected officials, budget timelines, and the creation of citizen participation mechanisms in the charter.

items.title: Public Comment and Survey Deadline
items.summary: Leadership made a final call for public feedback and reminded residents that the charter study survey closes on January 31st.
